items.topic: plainName pattern allows dots; README example wrong
items.claim: Reader claimed plainName has a bug because it keeps dots
items.fact: The code deliberately allows '.' in its pattern since first commit; the README example is what is wrong.

items.claim: Docs give wrong Java/Maven versions (21.0.4-zulu / 3.9.9)
items.fact: Docs say .sdkmanrc comes from ./judo.sh generate-root; the root template pins 21.0.7-zulu / 3.9.10 matching docs. 21.0.4-zulu/3.9.9 is the application module's copy of the file.

items.topic: Debounced autocomplete example broken for different reason
items.claim: debounce returns undefined after first call
items.fact: lodash debounce returns the previous call's result/promise after the first call, so results come back for an older search; only first call(s) return undefined.

items.topic: hiddenBy on menu items points to principal object
items.claim: Reference to 'UI Authoring Guide §6' / §5 table says owner object
items.fact: Correct reference is §9 (line 264): on menu items hiddenBy points to the principal object, not the owner object.

items.topic: AUTO vs MANUAL duplicate-check contradicts comment
items.claim: Code contradicts own comment for AUTO vs MANUAL duplicate check
items.fact: Confirmed code/comment mismatch; may be intended domain logic.

items.claim: doc says src/test/ is empty
items.fact: The folder does not exist at all.
AsmModel.java:827 build() assigns this.uri after uriPhysicalOrLogical computed, so URI of a supplied AsmModelResourceSupport is ignored; model gets 'asm.model' or uri() argument.
AsmUtilsCache.java:90 clear() does not clear annotationsByModelElementAndName, so cached annotation lookups (including misses) survive; enrichWithAnnotations() relies on clear() to invalidate.

items.topic: loadAsmModel passes raw null uri to setupRelativeUriRoot
items.fact: AsmModel.java:248 uses loadArguments.uri (possibly null) for setupRelativeUriRoot while the model uses default 'asm.model'; they may disagree.

items.claim: root AGENTS.md: EsmMeasureProvider registers an EContentAdapter so MeasureChangedHandler sees live edits
items.fact: Adapter is registered but notifyChanged only calls super; handler parameter is never used, so the handler is never called.
EsmModelAdapter.java:350 `mr.getBinding()==null && mr.getBinding()==null` should check `ir` on second operand (line 346 attribute check correct).
EsmMeasureProvider.java:107 looks up running exponent by term's measure rather than base measure m being accumulated.

items.claim: jql-parser spec: parseString(null) returns null
items.fact: loadJqlFromString null-checks but parseString then calls getErrors() on null -> NPE.
Never closes FileInputStream; each call leaks a handle.
Unlike parseString they don't throw JqlParseException on syntax errors; return partial/null AST.

items.topic: JqlDslUnregisterCallback unregisters by model name not bundle
items.fact: Rejected duplicate bundle removal can unregister first bundle's live service; should unregister per owning bundle. Also OSGi tracker doesn't null-check getEntry(file=) so missing entry throws NPE not caught by IOException catch.

items.claim: FunctionCall has parameters/lambdaArgument; update-category-versions exists; .psmjql registered
items.fact: parameters and lambdaArgument are on the Function rule, not FunctionCall; update-category-versions profile doesn't exist; .psmjql isn't registered in this repo.

items.claim: `mvn clean install -P update-category-versions -f site/pom.xml` (AGENTS.md:81,115; README.md:206; CONTRIBUTING.md:31)
items.fact: Neither site/pom.xml nor root POM defines that profile (seen in judo-meta-query, jql, others). Similarly update-target-versions profile and targetdefinition/ dir don't exist in another repo.

items.topic: sonar.java.source uses undefined ${java.version}: NOT a bug
items.claim: pom.xml:129 sonar.java.source=${java.version} with no property defined
items.fact: Validators ruled reader wrong: Maven fills JVM system property java.version at build time. Not a bug (C219, C264, C270).

items.topic: JSL docs describe syntax grammar doesn't accept
items.claim: docs use bind:true, on:before|after event handlers, human: actors, link/table/group members; unions need >=2 members
items.fact: JslDsl.xtext uses `<=>` for transfer binding, has no on:before/after or parameters, no human: and no link/table/group actor members; unions accept one member. Grammar inconsistency bind ?= SSH (line 175) vs bind = SSH (297) is different rules.

items.claim: reader: AGENTS.md:27 puts RestUtils in api layer
items.fact: Line says 'impl-layer RestUtils' which matches code.
JavaApiHelper.java:47 replaceAll(".", "/") treats '.' as regex wildcard; confirmed bug but namespaceElementApiFqPath is unused so no effect on output today.

items.topic: Template helpers resolve across api/impl/osgi artifacts
items.claim: reader: {{ self.applicationClassName }} renders empty; namedElementRestPath unresolved in api template
items.fact: Helpers are resolved via StaticMethodValueResolver; generation loads api, impl and osgi artifacts together so scan picks up impl module's JavaImplHelper. Not bugs.

items.claim: reader: spec saying real implementation with higher ranking replaces stub is a conflict
items.fact: True: stub sets no ranking (default), higher-ranked service wins.

items.claim: -dialog-title is the only dialog suffix generated
items.fact: Filter leaves also get -action-cancel, -action-clear-all, -action-apply and -close (VisualElementHelper.java:293-299).

items.claim: referenced only as an artifact
items.fact: No pom.xml references it; appears only in README.md.

items.claim: forceSnapshotOverwrite disables snapshot check
items.fact: Flag exists to refresh snapshots so not failing is intended (DiffCheckerMojo.java:71-75).

items.topic: ACTIONS_HOOK_INTERFACE_KEY names start with page/container name
items.claim: doc lists *_ACTIONS_HOOK_INTERFACE_KEY names
items.fact: Doc omits that each key begins with the page or container name. Per-page key (pages/customization.ts.hbs:13) includes actor, entity, page-type; pageActionInterfaceKey builds separate per-action keys.

items.claim: reader said note wrong
items.fact: build:reckless = plain vite build: no type checking, no caching layer. Doc correct. Progress.tsx.hbs:44 Math.floor doesn't zero result.

items.fact: isReadOnly is a real separate flag in ui.ecore:125 set by JSL transform viewWidgetDeclaration.etl:17.

items.claim: drawer and mobile menus have no logout
items.fact: Both open ProfilePopup which has its own logout item; doLogout in DrawerProfile/BottomProfile is unused dead code.

items.claim: LazyTable.tsx.hbs:732 rowCount={rowsPerPage} bug; main.tsx.hbs:91 redirect_uri=window.location.href bug
items.fact: Judged deliberate: cursor paging with own pagination control showing total; redirect returns user to previous page. Judgement calls.

items.topic: Unused isMd/isLg/isXl not lint failure; autocomplete hint ref pattern deliberate
items.claim: Drawer/index.tsx.hbs:68 unused vars break lint; AutocompleteNoResultsHint useRef+empty-deps useCallback bug
items.fact: noUnusedLocals not set in tsconfig and Biome linter disabled: dead code only. useRef pattern keeps same paper component across renders so MUI doesn't remount (autocomplete-more-results-hint change tasks.md 1.1a).

items.claim: entities vs _default_transferobjecttypes contradiction
items.fact: Real problem: text says interface under sdk.* while example implements operation.*. entities vs _default_transferobjecttypes not a contradiction.

items.fact: Table has no autoCompleteRows field in ui.ecore and nothing calls it.

items.claim: bug: 404 page composed without catalogs
items.fact: Likely copied from upstream Antora 2.x (intentional, no navigation); from memory, unverified. osgi-configuration-mapper precedence conflict confirmed only as internal doc contradiction.

items.claim: AGENTS.md:162,108 and CONTRIBUTING.md:150: Lombok must not be used in Tycho eclipse-plugin
items.fact: Root pom.xml:833 declares lombok unscoped in top-level dependencies so every child incl. model/ eclipse-plugin inherits it.

items.topic: Maven bundle repo AGENTS.md counts and release claims
items.claim: 44 modules; every release goes to Nexus and Central; release-judong targets nexus.judo.technology; no source code; org.restlet only multi-module bundle
items.fact: Root POM lists 43 modules; three modules lack release-judong profile; grpc uses repository.judo.technology; jxls 2.6.0/2.10.0/3.0.0 and xtext 2.39.0 contain Java sources; two Lucene modules are also multi-module.

common/pom.xml verifies opencensus (defined only in google module); eclipse-emf-2.27 installs ecore 2.29.0; eclipse-emf/pom.xml verify list has stray '>' and omits eclipse-emf-2.40; apache-commons lists beanutils twice; apache-httpclient declares karaf-maven-plugin twice; stray 'Import-Package>' in api-client-1.23.0 and calendar POMs; gcloud embeds protobuf 4.31.1 vs others import [3.25,4); com.google.api.client.* exported by both api-client 1.23.0 and 2.8.0; grpc and gcloud both export com.google.cloud.*.
getProperty(key, defaultValue) returns null unconditionally in jxls 2.6.0, 2.10.0, 3.0.0.
Line 477 isAddNewLine() returns on first cell in loop; line 209 sameStyleBelow unused and previousParagraphStyleName never updated (dead code).

items.claim: README documents custom-prefix argument
items.fact: Script ignores the custom-prefix arg, turns ../../../X into platform:/resource/../X, and sed -i fails on macOS BSD sed (reproduced).

items.claim: reader: SLF4J 2.0.15 row, EGX engine plugin, release repo URL wrong
items.fact: SLF4J arrives via Logback 1.5.12 via Epsilon runtime; EGX has no own plugin (inside org.eclipse.epsilon.egl.engine in core feature); release repository pointing at snapshots URL is same in all 98 JUDO repos, deliberate.

items.claim: multi-line <pattern> puts line breaks/spaces in log output
items.fact: Validator believes Logback trims it but didn't check source or run.

round.py runs readers (judo-ng-reader, @explore model) and validators (judo-ng-validator, @validate model, 6 batches each; batch fails if >1 in 4 reader claims wrong). Batches producing no output are auto-split (C304->a/b). Proxy error 'No active credentials for provider: claude' (404) hit mid-run; failed batches must be returned to queue unsplit in queue-state.json (not a size problem). Reader prompts may mention 'src' while batch is docs/POM-only; readers follow reader-prompt. Checker only validates format (line numbers exist, symbols in file), not truth. Scripts can overwrite dox_check values - re-check. kb guard warned 'repeated source searching, no kb consult' - run kb_search first.
